newsitem.title: USA: Jitney starts $30/shr tender of Delchamps.
newsitem.headline: Jitney starts $30/shr tender of Delchamps.

text.p: Jitney-Jungle Stores of America Inc said Monday it started its tender offer for Delchamps Inc for $30.00 a share in cash.
The regional supermarket chain first announced the offer July 8. The offer expires August 8 at 2400 EDT/0400 GMT, Jitney-Jungle said.

The company said it could extend the offer until September 12 to meet certain conditions, including regulatory approval under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 andd the consent of holders of Jitney-Jungle outstanding senior notes.
Jitney-Jungle said both companies' boards of directors have approved the offer.
The deal values Delchamps, which operates 118 supermarkets in the South, at about $213 million. Delchamps had about 7.12 million shares outstanding as of March 31.
Delchamps, which traded as high as 32-3/8 days before Jitney-Jungle announced its offer, closed at 29-3/4 Friday.
Jitney-Jungle said Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp will serve as the tender offer's dealer manager.
